description: We're an Argentine team of developers and data builders turning NASA data into farm decisions. Farmers face erratic climate, scarce water and degraded soil. Ashfield compares 3+ crop rotations, including the current one, explains each and cites its data (POWER soil moisture, GPM rain, MODIS vegetation), and flags uncertainty for a local agronomist to verify. Join a team with a working demo and real validation. We seek an agronomist, remote sensing/statistics and video/design skills.
